separation_statement: the standard deviation in this table is the sample standard deviation across independent TRAINING seeds (ddof=1). The intervals in Outputs B and D are image-clustered evaluation-sampling intervals that condition on the fixed trained seed set. The two are different quantities, neither bounds the other, and neither is described as the other anywhere in this closure. A clustered interval is never called training-seed uncertainty
